AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.src.label: Effect File
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.src.hint: Choose an image or video texture. Transparent WebM files work especially well for atmospheric effects.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.target.label: FX Target
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.target.hint: Choose where the visual is rendered: across the Region, on qualifying Tokens inside it, or as a fixed overlay on the viewer's screen.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.triggerOwnersh: Controls which Tokens are allowed to activate the effect. Player-Owned means a Token owned by at least one non-GM player; NPC / Unowned means a Token without a non-GM player owner.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.audience.label: Audience
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.audience.hint: Controls who sees the visual after it is triggered. Token Owners is evaluated separately on each connected client.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.opacity.label: Opacity
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.opacity.hint: Final transparency after fade-in. 0 is invisible and 1 is fully opaque.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.scale.label: Scale
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.scale.hint: Scales the effect relative to its target bounds. 1 fills the target using the selected Fit Mode.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fit.label: Fit Mode
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fit.hint: Stretch fills the target bounds exactly. Cover keeps the source aspect ratio and fills the bounds. Contain keeps the aspect ratio and fits entirely inside the bounds.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fadeIn.label: Fade In (ms)
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fadeIn.hint: How long the visual takes to fade in, in milliseconds. Use 0 for an instant appearance. 500 = half a second.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fadeOut.label: Fade Out (ms)
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fadeOut.hint: How long the visual takes to fade out, in milliseconds. Use 0 for an instant disappearance. 500 = half a second.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.clipToRegion.h: Region target only. When enabled, the visual is masked by the Region polygon instead of merely using its rectangular bounds.
